verdict.rationale: Replit is a development platform, so official SDKs are a fair axis to ask about, but nothing in the evidence documents an official Replit SDK or client library. The Replit MCP Server (replit-docs-42), the MCP client integrations and the third-party integrations are adjacent capabilities that belong to other stories, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
